answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. This holds because a newly minted alias starts worthless, so the attacker must first farm credibility on each one before it can swing a verdict. Consider a garden as the anchor of the cost.
